intro.zh: 采集与审核简报已发布，本期未收录新论文。发布前采集与审核记录：北京时间08:04–08:13实际尝试12路信源。HF 11/08榜未就绪，API开放至11/06；11/07请求返回200空列表，11/06完整榜为32篇，比前次新增1个晚到成员Coca-Cola，已复审为范围排除。五路RSS返回59条窗口内记录，GitHub检查13个仓库、窗口内release为0。三路arXiv查询为2次超时和1次429；S2引文成功页含2919条原始记录、窗口内327条（去重295条），匿名限流导致遍历未完成，作者源未取得论文页。对账新增19个身份，5项通过范围复核、按11/04或11/05原来源日期补刊；13项排除，Evolver保留机制边界。ELLMO随后恢复官方正文，确有提示优化，但属于信息抽取应用，不计Harness核心专题。另完成432条历史积压的逐条来源与范围复核，12项历史补录、413项排除、7项边界待补；独立第三轮覆盖全部25项原非排除候选并分层抽查14项排除记录。9项原始身份缺口已补齐。合并新发现与来源重试后，本次审核单共456项：428排除、12历史补录、16待补（8项机制边界、8项原始正文或方法缺口）。没有把旧论文改期为今日新增；采集快照不表示之后榜单不会更新。
intro.en: Collection and review bulletin published; no new papers were included. Collection and review record before publication: All 12 enabled sources were attempted at 08:04–08:13 Asia/Shanghai. The Nov 8 HF board was not ready, with availability through Nov 6; Nov 7 returned HTTP 200 with an empty list. The complete Nov 6 board contained 32 papers, adding late member Coca-Cola, reviewed as outside Harness scope. Five RSS feeds returned 59 window records; 13 GitHub repositories had no window releases. Three arXiv queries yielded two timeouts and one HTTP 429. Successful S2 citation pages held 2,919 raw records and 327 window records (295 deduplicated); anonymous throttling left traversal unfinished, and author tracking obtained no paper pages. Reconciliation added 19 identities: five passed scope review for supplements dated Nov 4 or Nov 5, 13 were excluded, and Evolver remains a mechanism boundary. ELLMO subsequently recovered official full text: its prompt optimization is real, but the information-extraction application is outside core Harness scope. Source and scope reviews also completed for 432 historical records: 12 historical backlog inclusions, 413 exclusions and seven boundaries. Independent third-round review covered all 25 initially non-excluded candidates and 14 stratified negative samples. Nine original identity gaps were resolved. Across the combined 456-row review, decisions are 428 exclusions, 12 historical backlog records and 16 deferrals (eight mechanism boundaries and eight original-text or methods gaps). Older papers were not relabeled as today’s new papers; this collection snapshot does not rule out later board updates.
